name: Gradient-blob field / cloud floor
description: One editable layer of soft drifting colour blobs (B58). mode field = a full-frame mesh gradient that flows (Lovable / Stripe style grounds, the field inside a button or behind a prompt box); mode floor = a billowing cloud floor with a lumpy soft top edge, transparent above it, that can rise in from below (the blue-to-white glow under a dark UI). Apply right after the ground, before content.
source: r06 S2.E2 blue-to-white cloud floor rising under the prompt bar f97-372 (y 1088 -> 680 f97-112 easeOutCubic, opacity f97-108)
r10 S9.E1 / S11.E1 / S12.E1 full-frame cream / pink / blue / magenta mesh fields f296-312, f426-548

mode.description: floor = cloud floor from the bottom (transparent above the edge); field = full-frame mesh gradient.

palette.description: auto = sky for floor, lovable for field. sky: #215cc4 -> #e0e9f8 (r06); lovable: cream / pink / blue / coral / lilac (r10); sunset: plum / coral / orange; mono: greys.

floor.description: Floor mode: top edge height as a fraction of the comp height from the bottom.

seed.description: Layout seed: change it for another arrangement.

rise.description: Floor: rise in from below and fade in (r06). Field: fade in.

riseFrames.description: Rise / fade length, frames at 30 fps.

name.description: Layer name ('' = Cloud Floor / Blob Field).
